svg.title: Bounce board architecture
svg.desc: USB-C PD input feeds a PD sink and load switch, a 20 to 24 V boost, a fused 24 V rail and the WS2805 strip. The 24 V rail also feeds a 5 V buck, a 3.3 V LDO, the ESP32 and a level shifter that drives the strip data line. The ESP32 reads the PD contract over I2C.
svg.text: I²C: ESP32 reads the PD contract
